funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small up to £2,000; Large from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage of their career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication, with a publisher confirmed and publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering costs such as image licensing, subventions, contributor fees and translation.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. One Research Project Grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in British art, primarily supporting staff costs toward facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; exhibition can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis on items in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections relating to British art.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to make their collections freely available online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a Member of ERBA (Emerging Researchers in British Art); membership can be pending at the time of application.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grants for ERBA Members to support a specific research trip (travel, accommodation and reasonable expenses) to visit libraries, archives, collections or sites, or to meet contacts or attend research-related events. Funding to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Tiered by career stage: up to £8,000 available to individuals at any career stage; £8,001-£20,000 available to those at postdoctoral level or with equivalent research experience or above. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research in British art, supporting research time (including staff backfill) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country, researching British works on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.
opportunities.summary: Funded by the Andrew Wyld Fund, these grants provide flexible financial support for students to undertake research trips to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, beginning between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art, designed to bring new perspectives to the understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £96,000, awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028, who have not yet begun their doctorate. International applicants may apply but receive a fixed £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for doctoral research in British art, paying university fees with the remainder supporting living expenses, plus an extra £500 per year for networking/mentorship activities. Part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: One year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 total (paid £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major research project in British art that will reshape understanding of the field, taken over one or two years. Part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to internationally recognised experts.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
